Sidhu Suraj was a famous Hindu warrior and king of the Sisodia Rajput clan. He ruled the Mewar kingdom during the late 13th and early 14th century. He is best known for his bravery during the siege of Chittorgarh fort, where he sacrificed his life rather than surrender to the invading army.
